description: Bug repro (player report): after confirming one unit's placement, selecting the NEXT unit to deploy (a real DeploymentController.begin_deploy() call, exactly what clicking a unit row does) sets that unit's status to DEPLOYING. Before the fix, GameState.all_units_deployed() and DeploymentPhase._all_units_deployed() only treated UNDEPLOYED as 'not done', so a merely-selected-but-not-yet-placed unit counted as deployed. With every OTHER unit for the player already confirmed DEPLOYED, that made the phase-action button light up and the pad Start (☰, hint text 'Confirm / End') button end the ENTIRE deployment phase — showing the first-turn roll-off popup — while the selected unit (here Custodian Guard) had zero models actually placed. Sets up 6-of-7 player-1 units as already DEPLOYED via direct state mutation (placement geometry is covered elsewhere, e.g. blade_champion_in_zone_deploy.json / tut_t2_musterin.json), then drives the real begin_deploy() + pad Start press for the 7th.

steps.comment: Setup shortcut: fast-forward every OTHER unit for BOTH players straight to DEPLOYED (placement geometry is exercised by other scenarios) so only U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B remains anywhere on the board, isolating the DEPLOYING-status guard. all_units_deployed() scans units for both players, so player 2's units must be cleared too or they mask the regression regardless of the fix.
still one UNDEPLOYED unit -- pre-existing guard, not the regression itself
DEPLOYING -- set the instant the unit is selected, before any model is placed or Confirm is pressed
THE FIX: a DEPLOYING unit must not count as done
the physical Start/☰ button the player pressed, hinted 'Confirm / End' throughout placement
must still be DEPLOYMENT -- this is the exact regression: phase used to end here
placement session on Custodian Guard must not have been disturbed
the 'who takes the first turn' popup must not appear
server-side validator must also reject an explicit END_DEPLOYMENT while Custodian Guard is only DEPLOYING
